life_history: Sarah is a working mother with a two-year-old son who presented for a well-woman exam. She works full-time and recently started taking night classes, resulting in a highly demanding and stressful schedule. Over the past year, her smoking has increased to about eight cigarettes a day, with the majority consumed in the evening after her son goes to bed. She also uses alcohol to cope with her busy schedule and unwind.
intermediate_beliefs: Positive assumption: If I engage in smoking and drinking in the evenings, then I can relax, unwind, and cope with my crazy schedule; negative assumption: If I stop smoking and drinking, then the distress and stress of work, school, and motherhood will overwhelm me.
intermediate_beliefs_during_depression: If I try to change my routine and fail, it proves I have no willpower and am incapable of managing my life's demands without a chemical crutch.
coping_strategies: Maladaptive coping includes smoking around eight cigarettes daily and consuming up to two alcoholic drinks a day to unwind, as well as defensively downplaying her consumption by comparing herself to coworkers. Adaptive coping and harm-reduction attempts include strictly avoiding smoking around her son, planning to cut her evening cigarettes from five to three, and agreeing to see a counselor for stress management.

cognitive_models.situation: Arriving home after working full-time, attending night classes, and finally putting her two-year-old son to bed.
cognitive_models.automatic_thoughts: My schedule is kinda crazy right now. I enjoy that time to myself in the evening. I need to smoke and have a drink to relax.
cognitive_models.behavior: Smoking 5-6 cigarettes and having a drink or two alone in the evening.

cognitive_models.situation: The healthcare provider specifically asks how many drinks she has over the course of a week.
cognitive_models.automatic_thoughts: I don't really get why you're asking me that. I just came here for a regular visit. I am not here to talk about my drinking.
cognitive_models.behavior: Becoming defensive, pushing back against the provider's questioning, and attempting to deflect the topic of alcohol.

cognitive_models.situation: The provider details the severe health risks associated with smoking and drinking, including various cancers.
cognitive_models.automatic_thoughts: You brought up some kinda scary stuff. Being a mother, I don't want something to happen to me. But I don't smoke or drink that much compared to people I work with.
cognitive_models.behavior: Minimizing her use compared to others while simultaneously agreeing to a harm-reduction plan of cutting back to 3 evening cigarettes.
